title: Baroque Rhetorical Architecture and Emphatic Tropes

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: Péter Pázmány established the Hungarian literary sentence in the 17th century. His style is characterized by majestic periodic periods (*körmondat*), rich sensory metaphors drawn from everyday peasant life, and thundering antitheses.

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: In modern C1 prose, echoing baroque cadence means balancing passionate rhetorical conviction (*pátosz*) with rigorous logical clarity (*logikai fegyelem*).
